examples.en: She felt a deep emptiness after the holidays ended.
examples.zh: 假期结束后，她感到一种深深的空虚。

examples.en: The young lieutenant led his platoon into the village.
examples.zh: 那位年轻的中尉带领他的排进入了村庄。

examples.en: Her old grandfather wrote a will and testament.
examples.zh: 她年迈的祖父写下了一份遗嘱。

examples.en: The guards hustled the prisoner out of the room.
examples.zh: 警卫匆忙地把犯人推出了房间。

examples.en: The children ran barefoot along the warm sandy beach.
examples.zh: 孩子们赤着脚沿着温暖的沙滩奔跑。

examples.en: Doctors prefer less invasive surgery whenever it is possible.
examples.zh: 只要有可能，医生都倾向于创伤较小的手术。

examples.en: She stayed upbeat even when things went badly wrong.
examples.zh: 即使事情严重出错，她仍然保持乐观。

examples.en: The ruthless boss fired anyone who made a mistake.
examples.zh: 那个无情的老板会解雇任何犯错的人。

examples.en: Half the patients received a placebo instead of medicine.
examples.zh: 一半的病人服用的是安慰剂而不是药物。

examples.en: The new law will outlaw smoking in public parks.
examples.zh: 这项新法律将禁止在公共公园里吸烟。

examples.en: The terrible accident left him a cripple for life.
examples.zh: 那场可怕的事故使他终身残废。

examples.en: The old singer sang a sad ballad about love.
examples.zh: 那位老歌手唱了一首关于爱情的悲伤歌谣。

examples.en: The little girl wore her hair in a long braid.
examples.zh: 那个小女孩把头发扎成一条长辫子。

examples.en: We rested under a shady tree during the hot afternoon.
examples.zh: 炎热的下午，我们在一棵荫凉的树下休息。

examples.en: She did not waver in her decision to leave.
examples.zh: 她离开的决心毫不动摇。

examples.en: The teacher explained the most salient points of the lesson.
examples.zh: 老师讲解了这节课最突出的要点。

examples.en: Vultures gathered around the carcass of the dead deer.
examples.zh: 秃鹫聚集在那头死鹿的尸体周围。

examples.en: A careful motorist always slows down near schools.
examples.zh: 谨慎的驾车者总是在学校附近减速。

examples.en: He spent two years writing the screenplay for the film.
examples.zh: 他花了两年时间为这部电影写剧本。

examples.en: The radius of this circle is exactly five centimeters.
examples.zh: 这个圆的半径正好是五厘米。

examples.en: The king decided to banish the traitor from the country.
examples.zh: 国王决定将那个叛徒驱逐出这个国家。

examples.en: The magician pulled a white rabbit from his hat.
examples.zh: 魔术师从帽子里变出一只白兔子。

examples.en: The old woman's prophecy about the war came true.
examples.zh: 那位老妇人关于战争的预言成真了。

examples.en: She used a broom to sweep the kitchen floor.
examples.zh: 她用扫帚扫了厨房的地板。

examples.en: I appreciate your candid opinion about my new plan.
examples.zh: 我很感激你对我的新计划坦白的看法。

examples.en: She bought a trendy jacket from a popular shop.
examples.zh: 她从一家热门店里买了一件时髦的夹克。

examples.en: The fans screamed in ecstasy when the band appeared.
examples.zh: 乐队出场时，粉丝们欣喜若狂地尖叫起来。

examples.en: The whole class sang the song in unison.
examples.zh: 全班同学齐声唱了这首歌。

examples.en: Giving up now is simply unthinkable for our team.
examples.zh: 对我们团队来说，现在放弃简直是不可想象的。

examples.en: The queen will bestow a medal on the brave soldier.
examples.zh: 女王将把一枚奖章授予那位勇敢的士兵。

examples.en: New immigrants often need time to assimilate into society.
examples.zh: 新移民往往需要时间才能融入社会。

examples.en: She added a fresh red beet to the salad.
examples.zh: 她在沙拉里加了一个新鲜的红甜菜。

examples.en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around his wound.
examples.zh: 护士在他的伤口上缠了一条干净的绷带。

examples.en: His golf ball landed right in the middle of the fairway.
examples.zh: 他的高尔夫球正好落在球道的中央。

examples.en: We could barely see anything in the evening gloom.
examples.zh: 在傍晚的幽暗中，我们几乎看不见任何东西。

examples.en: It is a common misconception that bats are blind.
examples.zh: 认为蝙蝠是瞎的是一个常见的误解。

examples.en: You must sign a waiver before joining the climbing trip.
examples.zh: 参加攀岩活动前你必须签一份弃权声明书。

examples.en: Her long hair was in a terrible tangle this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上她的长发缠成了乱糟糟的一团。

examples.en: Let's rearrange the furniture to make the room bigger.
examples.zh: 我们重新摆放家具，让房间显得更大些吧。

examples.en: As a frequent flier, he knows every airport well.
examples.zh: 作为一名常坐飞机的旅客，他对每个机场都很熟悉。

examples.en: We must hasten home before the storm arrives.
examples.zh: 我们必须在暴风雨来临前赶快回家。

examples.en: He reads a weekly digest of all the major news.
examples.zh: 他每周读一份所有重大新闻的文摘。

examples.en: The ship hit the sharp, jagged rocks near the shore.
examples.zh: 船撞上了岸边那些尖锐的锯齿状岩石。

examples.en: The new medicine can prolong the patient's life by years.
examples.zh: 这种新药可以将病人的生命延长好几年。

examples.en: He ate a sweet chocolate doughnut for breakfast.
examples.zh: 他早餐吃了一个甜甜的巧克力油炸圈饼。

examples.en: The doctor found a serious dysfunction in his liver.
examples.zh: 医生发现他的肝脏有严重的机能障碍。

examples.en: He refused to relinquish control of the family company.
examples.zh: 他拒绝放弃对家族公司的控制权。

examples.en: The ceremony will commence at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 典礼将于明天上午九点开始。

examples.en: She was hesitant to answer the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她对回答这个难题犹豫不决。

examples.en: A sudden flurry of snow covered the quiet street.
examples.zh: 一阵突如其来的小雪覆盖了安静的街道。

examples.en: She waited for the test results with great apprehension.
examples.zh: 她怀着极大的忧惧等待着检查结果。

examples.en: Fallen leaves can easily clog the garden drain.
examples.zh: 落叶很容易堵塞花园的排水沟。

examples.en: The weather was cold, wet, and truly dismal.
examples.zh: 天气又冷又湿，真是令人忧郁。

examples.en: His speech contained several noteworthy and interesting ideas.
examples.zh: 他的演讲包含了几个值得注意的有趣想法。

examples.en: A long plume decorated the soldier's tall hat.
examples.zh: 一根长长的羽毛装饰着那名士兵的高帽子。

examples.en: I love the natural sweetness of ripe summer fruit.
examples.zh: 我喜欢成熟夏季水果那种天然的甜味。

examples.en: The infantry marched bravely toward the enemy lines.
examples.zh: 步兵勇敢地朝着敌军阵线前进。

examples.en: My older sister is still unmarried at thirty.
examples.zh: 我姐姐三十岁了还未婚。

examples.en: The teacher complained about his sloppy and untidy work.
examples.zh: 老师抱怨他的作业粗心而不整洁。

examples.en: The two meetings were concurrent, so I missed one.
examples.zh: 这两个会议同时举行，所以我错过了一个。

examples.en: Please restart the router to fix the slow internet.
examples.zh: 请重启路由器以解决网络变慢的问题。

examples.en: The page header shows the title and the date.
examples.zh: 页眉显示着标题和日期。

examples.en: She studies semantics, the meaning of words and sentences.
examples.zh: 她研究语义学，即词语和句子的意义。

examples.en: Each iteration of the loop adds one to the total.
examples.zh: 循环的每一次迭代都会给总数加一。

examples.en: Lambda is the eleventh letter of the Greek alphabet.
examples.zh: Lambda 是希腊字母表中的第十一个字母。

examples.en: We performed a rollback to restore the previous version.
examples.zh: 我们执行了回滚以恢复到之前的版本。

examples.en: The dancers' synchronous movements impressed the whole audience.
examples.zh: 舞者们同步的动作给全场观众留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: There is a clear parallelism between the two stories.
examples.zh: 这两个故事之间有明显的类似之处。

examples.en: The graph clearly shows how sales rose each month.
examples.zh: 这张图表清楚地显示了每个月销售额的增长。

examples.en: A triangle has three sides and three vertex points.
examples.zh: 三角形有三条边和三个顶点。

examples.en: Sailors once used semaphore flags to send messages.
examples.zh: 水手们过去用旗语来传递信息。

examples.en: The program will serialize the data before saving it.
examples.zh: 程序会在保存数据之前先将其序列化。

examples.en: Decryption turns the secret code back into plain text.
examples.zh: 解密把秘密代码还原成普通文本。

examples.en: We use async functions to handle slow network requests.
examples.zh: 我们使用异步函数来处理缓慢的网络请求。

examples.en: A bitwise operation compares each bit of two numbers.
examples.zh: 按位运算会比较两个数字的每一位。

examples.en: A deque lets you add items at both ends.
examples.zh: 双端队列允许你在两端都添加元素。

examples.en: The app must deserialize the file into usable objects.
examples.zh: 应用必须把文件反序列化成可用的对象。

examples.en: We defined an enum to list the four seasons.
examples.zh: 我们定义了一个枚举来列出四个季节。

examples.en: A hashtable stores keys and values for fast lookup.
examples.zh: 哈希表存储键和值以便快速查找。

examples.en: This request is idempotent, so repeating it is safe.
examples.zh: 这个请求是幂等的，所以重复调用也很安全。

examples.en: A mutex prevents two threads from changing the data together.
examples.zh: 互斥量可以防止两个线程同时修改数据。

examples.en: We added a polyfill so old browsers support the feature.
examples.zh: 我们加了一个兼容补丁，让旧浏览器也支持这个功能。

examples.en: I will rebase my branch onto the latest main.
examples.zh: 我会把我的分支变基到最新的主分支上。

examples.en: He wrote a regexp to find all the email addresses.
examples.zh: 他写了一个正则表达式来查找所有电子邮件地址。

examples.en: The routing rules decide where each request goes.
examples.zh: 路由规则决定每个请求被发送到哪里。

examples.en: A set stores unique items without any duplicates.
examples.zh: 集合存储不重复的唯一元素。

examples.en: We use a struct to group related data together.
examples.zh: 我们用结构体把相关的数据组织在一起。

examples.en: A tuple holds several values in a fixed order.
examples.zh: 元组按固定顺序保存若干个值。

examples.en: Subtracting too much can cause a number underflow error.
examples.zh: 减得太多可能会导致数字下溢错误。
